statement.en: Where the rule reads the fast configuration only through what a pool reads of it, two courses with one rule at a reading step, read alike by the pool there, have one rule after it: rules part at a reading step only where the pool's reading parts.
statement.zh: 规则只经一池对快层构形之所读而读之时，读取步上规则相同、池所读相同之两历程，其后规则相同：规则只在池所读分开处于读取步分开。

laws.en: With h x g = H (read x) g, one rule and one reading of the pool at a reading step give one rule after it.
laws.zh: h x g = H (read x) g 时，读取步上规则同、池之所读同，则其后规则同。

hypotheses.en: No axiom; the two-layer course of Pace with the rule read through a map of the fast configuration.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理；Pace 之两层历程，规则经快层构形之一映射读取。

does_not_show.en: That an actual rule reads through a pool, or which pool.
does_not_show.zh: 实际之规则经池读取，或经何池。
